data.goal: You are on the Gymshark UK product listing. Steps: (1) accept the cookie banner if shown; (2) click through to any one purchasable product; (3) select an available size using the size control (its text may include a suffix, e.g. "M (10-12)" or "UK 9"); (4) set window.__bench_marker = performance.now() IMMEDIATELY before clicking add-to-cart, then click add-to-cart once; (5) wait about 5 seconds for the cart and tags to settle - do NOT re-click or re-poll repeatedly; (6) in ONE eval set window.__bench_report_at = performance.now() and window.__bench_finding to a JSON object with exactly these keys: {"consentAccepted": true if you accepted the banner, "productTitle": the product you added, "cartItemCount": the number of items now in the cart (read it from the \"cart\" field of your most recent observation after adding; it changes from 0/empty to the new count), "tagsAfterAdd": [every distinct hostname of a marketing tag (Google/GTM, DoubleClick/Floodlight, Facebook, TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest, Criteo, Clarity and similar) that loaded between your marker and report time, sorted]}. Do not enter payment or checkout. Finish only after window.__bench_finding is set.
